title: Render called twice with number values + urlSync
body:
The `hitsPerPageSelector` widget uses `helper.setQueryParameter('hitsPerPage', value)` with `value` being a `Number`.
The issue is that it causes `render` of the widget to be called twice, once with the `Number` value and the other time with a `String` value.
The easy workaround would be to use `helper.setQueryParameter('hitsPerPage', '' + value)`, but it might maybe make sense to set up expected types in the helper and automatically cast.
What do you think?

comments.body:
> The issue is that it causes render of the widget to be called twice, once with the Number value and the other time with a String value.

But why does it does that?

I believe that this is how it goes:
- We're setting the local state with `hitsPerPage: 6`
- The URL gets updated with `hPP=6`
- The URL was updated, so the URL sync widget checks if the state of the URL matches the local state
- It doesn't, since the state from the URL is `hitsPerPage: "6"`
- The local state gets updated with `hitsPerPage: "6"`, this triggers a `render` on all widgets

This one seems like an helper issue indeed.

We should either consider loose equality when it comes from the url, or keep track of Number/String types
Yep it can be fixed in the helper. On it!
I've tested with the branch. Just need the PR on the helper to be merged https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-helper-js/pull/246
